# Vendored syntext (generated)

Copied verbatim by `scripts/vendor-syntext.sh` from the syntext commit in
`REVISION`, which is the commit `Cargo.lock` resolves `syntext-context` to.
The C symbols these headers declare are compiled into `libturbospark_ffi.a`
(`crates/ffi`), so do not edit anything here: change syntext, then re-pin
and re-vendor. `scripts/swift-lib.sh` refuses a mismatched revision. See
`swift/docs/SYNTEXT.md`.
